Class_Skill_Desc_Hero's Rime: Increases damage dealt and healing potency of self and nearby party members by 10%, while reducing damage taken by 10%.</br>Duration: 20s</br>Effect cannot be stacked with Offensive Aria.
Class_Skill_Desc_Mighty March: Gradually restores own HP and the HP of all nearby party members.</br>Cure Potency: 3,500</br>Additional Effect: Increases maximum HP by 20% and restores the amount increased</br>Duration: 30s
Class_Skill_Desc_Offensive Aria: Increases damage dealt by self and nearby party members by 4%.</br>Duration: 70s</br>Effect cannot be stacked with Hero's Rime.
Class_Skill_Desc_Romeo's Ballad: Freezes time for all nearby enemies readying an attack.</br>Duration: 3s</br>Additional Effect: Grants Romeo's Ballad to self and nearby party members when executed within proximity of a knowledge crystal</br>Romeo's Ballad Effect: Increases Phantom EXP earned through battle by 10%</br>Duration: 30m
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Vocals: Increases the effectiveness of songs in accordance with your Phantom Bard level.
